Q: How to fix requires a peer of grunt@~0.4.0 while installing grunt plugins? A:

I have fixed the problem,

  • First, Ensured that the peer dependencies section in the package.json file is empty
  • Second, I updated npm using

npm update

  • Third, install grunt cli globally using

npm install -g grunt-cli.

  • Finally switched to the path where the project in and complete installing grunt itself and the plugins I need and worked well.

npm install grunt --save-dev

npm install grunt-contrib-watch --save-dev

npm install grunt-contrib-clean --save-dev

Q: Jacob com.jacob.com.ComFailException: Can't map name to dispid: A:

So I was getting this error and ultimately my problem was that I had two instances of the classes on the class-path. I had the classes of a dependent jar unpacked as well as the jar itself on the path. I got rid of the jar and voila it all started working beautifully.

Q: Selenium Chrome WebDriver how to scroll horizontally A:

Change the code: 

js.ExecuteScript("scrollTo(3000,0);");

to

js.ExecuteScript("scroll(3000,0);");

Simply, it's not scrollTo and scroll only.

Q: "Script References" in Visual Studio A:

Did you try removing the ~/scripts/_references.js from the Included files list in the Options dialog?

I'm also having trouble getting IntelliSense working correctly for js files.

Q: Looking for guidance on this journey A:

What do you really want to do? What is your long-term goal? What is your short-term goal? Do you want to work with something programming related? Is it going to be a hobby? Few people have the same paths, it might be shared from time to time but not for long, so it's going to be hard to give specific advice unless you're specific as well.

The main advice I can give for now is that you concentrate on your nearest short-term goal, learn the specific of what matters most to you right now. Once you reached that goal, you take some time to reevaluate your goals and what to learn next.

And please note that you never stop learning programming, it's a life-long journey.
